notes: GLB mesh node names that are real bone nodes in public/models/skeleton.glb but are NOT game answers. Currently empty: every node is mapped by data/bone_catalog.json (the four foot sesamoids are pooled into slug 'sesamoid-hallux'). BodyParts3D 4.0 contains no auditory ossicles and no coccyx, so those catalog entries are optional with no mesh. Sternum parts (Manubrium / Body of sternum / Xiphoid process) map to slug 'sternum'. The hip bone is a single mesh per side, so slug 'hip-bone' owns it and ilium/ischium/pubis are synonyms of it.
